biggest_catch: Both Visa cards are issued only after the new customer makes full payment of their SECOND consecutive bill — the referral side requires waiting ~2 billing cycles, and the 2013-dated program terms say the offered credit amount can change at any time before the referral enrolls.
catches: The Visa Reward Cards are sent only after 4Change receives full payment of the referred customer's second consecutive invoice.

The program terms PDF is dated 2013 and states the credit amount 'will be determined based upon 4Change Energy's current offer at the time of enrollment' — the $50 amount comes from the current official FAQ/blog copy, not the PDF.
Referred customer must be a new 4Change customer (not current, pending, or a customer within the prior 45 days) and must enroll using the referrer's personal link or referral code.
Referrer must be an existing residential electricity customer with an account in good standing; referrals of people not personally known violate terms.
Bill credits are forfeited if you cancel service or switch providers before they post.
Framing: Visa reward cards offset spending like bill savings; you must already be (or become) a 4Change customer to earn referrer-side cards.

steps: Log in to your 4Change Energy MyAccount.
Open Referral Rewards and copy your unique referral link.
Share the link with someone you know personally (email, text, social).
The new customer signs up with 4Change Energy using your link.
After 4Change receives full payment of the new customer's second consecutive bill, you and the new customer each receive a $50 Visa Reward Card.
timing: Cards are sent after the referred customer's second full bill payment (~2 billing cycles); the offered amount can change at any time before the referral enrolls.
